hooks.note: Key cancel filter: ctx+0xe4 is the translated key (set by FUN_000202ec for remote keys, FUN_0001d9b8, and FUN_0001b4a4 for HDMI-CEC keys, before the call); 1 drops it. The stock body drops 0x168 (Netflix) when APL_ENV_GetReplaceKey(0x700) != 0x700 and lets every key pass while ctx+0x64 == 2. Prologue ldr r3,[r0,#0x64]; push {r4,r5,r6,lr}.

variants.note: The filter moved +0x78 (FUN_0002e568); its machine code, ctx offsets (0x64, 0xe0, 0xe4) and its callers' use of it (FUN_0001e740 remote keys, FUN_0001f218, FUN_0001b4a4 HDMI-CEC; 1 drops the key) are the same as in 1.82.

external_imports: open and close from libc, resolved through the target's dynamic symbols.
lifecycle: apl_mgr runs from boot to power off; the payload is installed once per helper run.
